1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: __first and second members each having a web and a pair of flanges extending from the web, and a third member joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second, and third members intersecting to form__ a __void;__ a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of __structural__ adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the __at least one layer of composite__ fabric __layer__ covers the radius areas.

3. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of __structural__ adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of __structural__ adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __by a predetermined distance__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of __structural__ adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __exactly__ three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of __structural__ adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 13, wherein the layer of __structural__ adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __generally C-shaped in cross section__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape and having a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, the cap and the base including radius areas between the web and the flanges and the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric on the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of __structural__ adhesive joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
